mapper.sql: C.CMPL_NUMB , C.USER_NUMB , R.USER_NICK AS REPORTER_NICK , C.TAGT_TYPE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplTagt}, C.TAGT_TYPE, #{cmplTagt}) AS TAGT_TYPE_NAME , C.TAGT_NUMB , C.TAGT_HASH , C.TAGT_USER , C.TAGT_CNTN , CASE WHEN C.EVDC_NUMB IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS EVIDENCE_AVAILABLE , T.USER_NICK AS TARGET_USER_NICK , C.CMPL_RSON , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplRsonGroup}, C.CMPL_RSON, #{cmplRsonGroup}) AS CMPL_RSON_NAME , C.CMPL_CNTN , C.CMPL_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplStatGroup}, C.CMPL_STAT, #{cmplStatGroup}) AS CMPL_STAT_NAME , C.PROC_CNTN , C.PROC_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(C.PROC_ADMN) AS PROC_ADMN_NAME , C.PROC_DATE , C.REGI_DATE , C.UPDT_DATE

P.CMPL_NUMB , P.USER_NUMB , P.REPORTER_NICK , P.TAGT_TYPE , P.TAGT_TYPE_NAME , P.TAGT_NUMB , P.TAGT_HASH , P.TAGT_USER , P.TAGT_CNTN , P.EVIDENCE_AVAILABLE , P.TARGET_USER_NICK , P.CMPL_RSON , P.CMPL_RSON_NAME , P.CMPL_CNTN , P.CMPL_STAT , P.CMPL_STAT_NAME , P.PROC_CNTN , P.PROC_ADMN , P.PROC_ADMN_NAME , P.AUTO_ACTIONED , P.PROC_DATE , P.REGI_DATE , P.UPDT_DATE
mapper.select: SELECT /* getComplaintListCount */ COUNT(1) FROM TH_CMPLNT C LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM R ON R.USER_NUMB = C.USER_NUMB WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT /* getComplaintDtl */
FROM TH_CMPLNT C LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM R ON R.USER_NUMB = C.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM T ON T.USER_NUMB = C.TAGT_USER WHERE C.CMPL_NUMB = #{cmplNumb}

SELECT /* getComplaintForUpdate */ C.CMPL_NUMB , C.USER_NUMB , C.TAGT_TYPE , C.TAGT_NUMB , C.TAGT_HASH , C.TAGT_USER , C.TAGT_CNTN , C.CMPL_RSON , C.CMPL_CNTN , C.CMPL_STAT , C.PROC_CNTN , C.PROC_ADMN , C.PROC_DATE , C.REGI_DATE , C.UPDT_DATE FROM TH_CMPLNT C WHERE C.CMPL_NUMB = #{cmplNumb} FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getAutoActionList */ A.ACTN_NUMB , A.TAGT_TYPE , A.TAGT_NUMB , A.TAGT_HASH , A.TAGT_USER , A.ACTN_TYPE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplActnGroup}, A.ACTN_TYPE, #{cmplActnGroup}) AS ACTN_TYPE_NAME , A.RSLT_CODE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplRsltGroup}, A.RSLT_CODE, #{cmplRsltGroup}) AS RSLT_CODE_NAME , A.THRS_CNTT , A.CMPL_CNTT , A.ACTN_ORDR , A.TRIG_CMPL , A.RSLT_CNTN , A.REGI_DATE FROM TH_CMACTN A WHERE A.TAGT_TYPE = #{tagtType} AND A.TAGT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND A.TAGT_HASH = #{tagtHash} ORDER BY A.ACTN_ORDR DESC , A.ACTN_NUMB DESC
SELECT /* getComplaintEvidence */ E.ORIG_NAME , E.MIME_TYPE , E.EVDC_DATA FROM TH_CMPLNT C INNER JOIN TH_CMEVDC E ON E.EVDC_NUMB = C.EVDC_NUMB WHERE C.CMPL_NUMB = #{cmplNumb}

SELECT /* getResultEvent */ C.CMPL_NUMB AS TRIG_CMPL, C.TAGT_TYPE, C.TAGT_NUMB, C.TAGT_HASH, C.TAGT_USER , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplTagt}, C.TAGT_TYPE, NULL) AS TAGT_NAME , 1 AS RSON_CNTT, C.CMPL_RSON AS RSON_CODE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplRsonGroup}, C.CMPL_RSON, NULL) AS RSON_NAME , C.PROC_DATE FROM TH_CMPLNT C WHERE C.CMPL_NUMB = #{cmplNumb} AND C.CMPL_STAT = #{cmplActioned}
mapper.insert: INSERT /* setTargetResult */ INTO TH_CMRSLT (EVNT_NUMB, CMPL_NUMB, USER_NUMB, RCVR_TYPE, REGI_DATE) SELECT #{eventNumb}, #{cmplNumb}, U.USER_NUMB, #{receiverTarget}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND U.USER_STAT IN (#{active}, #{suspended})
mapper.select: SELECT /* getTagtProfFileForUpdate */ F.FILE_NUMB , F.STOR_NAME , F.FILE_PATH FROM TM_USERXM U INNER JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON F.FILE_NUMB = U.PROF_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} FOR UPDATE
SELECT /* getTagtBgimFileForUpdate */ F.FILE_NUMB , F.STOR_NAME , F.FILE_PATH FROM TM_USERXM U INNER JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON F.FILE_NUMB = U.BGIM_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE /* delTagtFileIfUnref */ F FROM TM_FILEXM F WHERE F.FILE_NUMB = #{fileNumb} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.PROF_NUMB = F.FILE_NUMB OR U.BGIM_NUMB = F.FILE_NUMB )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* delTargetUserIntroduction */ TM_USERXM SET INTR_CNTN = NULL WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND INTR_CNTN IS NOT NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE /* delTagtReportChildReply */ C FROM TB_REPLXX C INNER JOIN TM_REPORT P ON P.REPT_NUMB = C.REPT_NUMB AND P.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} WHERE C.REPT_NUMB = #{reptNumb} AND C.UPER_NUMB IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE /* delTargetClubIntroduction */ TM_CLUBXM SET CLUB_CNTN = NULL , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND CLUB_CNTN IS NOT NULL
